# DigitalOcean

> DigitalOcean is a cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling applications with compute, Kubernetes, databases, storage, networking, and AI infrastructure.

DigitalOcean provides developer-focused cloud infrastructure and platform services, including virtual machines, managed Kubernetes, serverless functions, managed databases, object storage, networking, observability, and AI products. Its documentation, API reference, tutorials, and product guides cover both foundational cloud workflows and production-scale application deployment.

## Documentation

- [Documentation Home](https://docs.digitalocean.com/): Central documentation hub for products, platform features, and operational guides.
- [Products Overview](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/): Entry point for product-specific documentation across compute, storage, networking, and databases.
- [API Documentation](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/api/): Reference docs for the DigitalOcean public API and resource operations.
- [CLI Documentation](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/doctl/): Reference for doctl commands, authentication, and automation workflows.
- [Paperspace Documentation](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/paperspace/): Documentation for Paperspace GPU cloud and machine learning workflows.
- [Release Notes](https://docs.digitalocean.com/release-notes/): Product and platform release notes across DigitalOcean services.
- [Support Home](https://docs.digitalocean.com/support/): Support policies, contact options, and account assistance resources.

## Compute and Application Platform

- [Droplets](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/droplets/): Documentation for virtual machines, images, resizing, backups, and lifecycle management.
- [Kubernetes](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/kubernetes/): Managed Kubernetes documentation for clusters, node pools, upgrades, and networking.
- [App Platform](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/app-platform/): Guides for deploying apps, workers, static sites, and managed services.
- [Functions](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/functions/): Serverless functions documentation for triggers, namespaces, and deployment workflows.
- [Container Registry](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/container-registry/): Documentation for storing, managing, and integrating container images.
- [GenAI Platform](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/genai-platform/): Documentation for DigitalOcean's managed generative AI platform capabilities.

## Storage and Databases

- [Managed Databases](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/databases/): Documentation for provisioning, securing, scaling, and operating managed database clusters.
- [Spaces](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/spaces/): Object storage documentation for buckets, access keys, CDN, and S3-compatible usage.
- [Volumes](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/volumes/): Block storage documentation for attaching, resizing, and snapshotting persistent disks.
- [Backups](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/backups/): Backup documentation for Droplets and supported recovery workflows.
- [Snapshots](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/snapshots/): Documentation for creating and restoring infrastructure snapshots.
- [Managed Caching](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/databases/managed-caching/): Documentation for managed Redis-compatible caching deployments.

## Networking and Security

- [Networking](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/): Overview of VPC, load balancers, firewalls, DNS, and related networking features.
- [VPC](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/vpc/): Documentation for private networking and network isolation between resources.
- [Load Balancers](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/load-balancers/): Guides for distributing traffic across Droplets and Kubernetes workloads.
- [Cloud Firewalls](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/firewalls/): Documentation for network-level traffic filtering and access control.
- [DNS](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/dns/): Documentation for domain management, records, and DNS configuration.
- [Reserved IPs](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/reserved-ips/): Documentation for static IP assignment and failover scenarios.
- [DDoS Protection](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/networking/ddos/): Documentation for platform DDoS mitigation capabilities and coverage.

## AI and GPU Infrastructure

- [GenAI Platform Overview](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/genai-platform): Product overview for managed AI application and inference workflows.
- [GPU Droplets](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/gpu-droplets): Product page for GPU-backed virtual machines for AI and accelerated computing.
- [Paperspace](https://www.digitalocean.com/products/paperspace): Product overview for GPU cloud, notebooks, and machine learning infrastructure.
- [Paperspace Notebooks](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/paperspace/notebooks/): Documentation for managed notebooks and interactive ML development environments.
- [Paperspace Machines](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/paperspace/machines/): Documentation for GPU and CPU virtual machines in Paperspace.
- [Paperspace Deployments](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/paperspace/deployments/): Documentation for serving machine learning models and inference endpoints.

## API, CLI, and Developer Tools

- [API Reference](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/api/): REST API reference for managing DigitalOcean resources programmatically.
- [API Getting Started](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/api/api-reference/): Overview of authentication, endpoints, and API resource structure.
- [doctl CLI](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/doctl/): Command-line interface reference for provisioning and automation.
- [doctl GitHub Repository](https://github.com/digitalocean/doctl): Source code and releases for the official DigitalOcean CLI.
- [PyDo](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/pydo/): Python client library documentation for the DigitalOcean API.
- [Terraform Provider](https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/terraform/reference/): Terraform provider reference for infrastructure as code workflows.
- [DigitalOcean API GitHub Repository](https://github.com/digitalocean/openapi): OpenAPI specification and related API definition resources.

- [Tutorials Home](https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tutorials): Library of tutorials for Linux, cloud infrastructure, and application deployment.
- [Community Home](https://www.digitalocean.com/community): Community hub for tutorials, questions, and educational resources.
- [Questions](https://www.digitalocean.com/community/questions): Community Q&A for troubleshooting and implementation guidance.
- [Latest Tutorials](https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tutorials?sort=latest): Recently published tutorials across development and operations topics.
- [Linux Basics Tag](https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tags/linux-basics): Introductory Linux tutorials and command-line learning resources.
- [Kubernetes Tag](https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tags/kubernetes): Tutorials covering Kubernetes concepts, deployment, and operations.
- [AI/ML Tag](https://www.digitalocean.com/community/tags/ai-ml): Tutorials related to artificial intelligence and machine learning workflows.
